name: [UPD🎃] Risky Catch 🎣
desc:
Take on rough seas, chase rare fish, and build your fleet. Push too hard, and the ocean will push back.

🎣 Fight, catch, and sell fish
🚤 Buy and customize boats and jetskis
🌊 Rough deep-seas and brave changing weather 
🎨 Customize your rod and upgrade your line
🦐 Choose bait to boost your luck
⚓ Manage fuel, flooding, and bilge pumps
🏆 Compete in fishing tournaments for rewards

Head farther out. Land a bigger catch. Make it back to shore.

llm.loop: head out to sea -> fight and catch fish -> sell for cash -> upgrade boats, rods and bait -> venture farther into rougher water
llm.objectives: catch bigger and rarer fish in dangerous seas and make it back to shore
llm.progression: cash, boats and jetskis, rod and line upgrades, bait, fleet
llm.instructions: fight, catch and sell fish, buy boats, brave weather, manage fuel and flooding, compete in tournaments
unique: risk/reward rough-sea physics with boat flooding and bilge pumps
llm.thumbnails: boats in big waves, 'REAL WAVES REAL DANGER', marlin catch, 'RIDE THE WAKE' jetski
llm.complexity_notes: ocean wave and boat physics, weather, flooding systems
